name: Cortegana (Spain)
description: Orange field with an embattled blue stripe along the upper edge, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cortegana (a castle on blue above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Cortegana; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
